svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 06/12 Botanical Garden (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A green ravine tucked into a corner of campus. Tall trees, running water, instant quiet. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
